# Athena Revenue Partners

> From founder-led to team-led. Built by operators, not consultants.

Co-founded by Kami Cekosh and Holly Phillips. We help funded B2B tech founders past product-market fit, usually $1M–$10M ARR with zero to two sellers, hire their first seller or get the seller they have closing on a real process. Seed founders may hire earlier. We also work with seed and Series A VCs, accelerators and portfolio support teams; same offers and pricing.

## Primary offers — enter at any step
- [The Hire](/offerings#the-hire): Base $3,500, about 4 weeks, 1:1, written hiring plan. Plus $6,500 adds scorecard, interview guide, custom role play, written 90-day ramp plan and Kami or Holly in final interviews for up to 3 finalists. No candidate sourcing or recruiting fees.
- [The Handoff](/offerings#the-handoff): $24K, signed offer through first 90 days, up to two sellers. Founder playbook before start, ramp from day one, weekly deal reviews/coaching, founder steps back deal by deal.
- [The Step Back](/offerings#the-step-back): $36K, 90 days, up to two sellers in seat 3–9 months and not closing independently. Weeks 1–3: calls, pipeline and separate founder/seller conversations, clear answer and written plan. Weeks 4–12: playbook, stages, qualification, ramp reset, weekly deal reviews/coaching and founder handoff.

## Beyond your first seller — secondary support
- Revenue Advisory: $5K–$15K/month depending on scope; forecast reviews, leadership coaching and an independent board read.
- Revenue Bridge: scoped per engagement; operating system before or alongside a new sales leader or CEO.
- Fractional revenue leadership: scoped to hours needed.

We work toward outcomes; no guaranteed results or promise of full ramp by day 90. Founder-led selling is a stage, not a failure. Most revenue problems are systems problems, not people problems.
